title: EffectCraft nightly deep-background icons
author: @skylartaylor

inputs.purpose: native padded Mac 1024 master; not upscaled from 256
native padded Mac 512 master (runtime Dock icon)

method.kind: original code-generated derivative of the project-owned icon
method.transform: Solve the background's weight per pixel from the colour's distance off the neutral ink/paper axis, then add only that weight times the background difference. Alpha, padding and the neutral foreground/detail RGBA are preserved. ICO/ICNS frames are scaled from the same recoloured masters (lanczos) and packed as PNG frames. No crescent, letter or badge.
method.generator: inline Python (zlib PNG decode/encode, ffmpeg lanczos scaling, struct-packed ICO/ICNS)

validation: Input/output hashes, PNG dimensions and exact ICO/ICNS member sizes checked locally; foreground and alpha compared pixel-for-pixel against the source masters. Native Explorer/Finder/iconutil/app-package qualification is unrun (needs Windows and macOS).
